description: This file defines a React hook 'useModalValidation' and related functions for managing validation state and error tooltips in modal dialogs within the Superset frontend. It includes interfaces for validation objects, a function to build error messages, and logic for validating individual sections or all sections, tracking errors, and notifying parent components.

methods.name: buildErrorTooltipMessage
methods.description: Generates a ReactNode containing a list of validation errors grouped by section, for display as a tooltip.

methods.name: useModalValidation
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages validation state for modal sections, providing functions to validate sections, validate all, and generate error tooltips.
